name: Actually Found In Raid
teaser: Tired of killing a PMC and the loot isn't "Found In Raid", even though you literally just found it in the raid? Actually Found In Raid will make sure that AI PMCs spawn with all items as Found In Raid.
description_html:
About

Actually Found In Raid is a simple clientside mod that will ensure all AI PMCs items are spawned as Found In Raid. Now when you loot a PMC, the items will be Found In Raid, like they should be, at least in my opinion.

The mod can be toggled on/off using Configuration Manager.

It is compatible with Fika.
